title.zh: 卷十 本紀第十 英宗前紀
title.raw: 卷十 本紀第十 英宗前紀 Volume 10 Annals 10: Yingzong Former Records

sentences.zh: 英宗法天立道仁明誠敬昭文憲武至德廣孝睿皇帝，諱祁鎮，宣宗長子也。

translations.literal: The Yingzong Emperor, patterning Heaven and establishing the Way, benevolent, bright, sincere, reverent, illustrious in culture, manifest in martial virtue, of utmost virtue, broadly filial, and sagely, taboo name Qizhen, was the Xuanzong Emperor's eldest son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yingzong—honored after death as one who patterned himself on Heaven, established the Way, and united benevolence, brilliance, sincerity, reverence, literary glory, martial achievement, supreme virtue, broad filial devotion, and sagely wisdom—was named Zhu Qizhen and was the eldest son of Emperor Xuanzong.

sentences.zh: 母貴妃孫氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Noble Consort Sun.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Noble Consort Sun.

sentences.zh: 生四月，立為皇太子，遂冊貴妃為皇后。

translations.literal: At four months he was established Crown Prince; the noble consort was then enfeoffed as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: When he was four months old he was named crown prince, and Noble Consort Sun was at once elevated to empress.

sentences.zh: 宣德十年春正月，宣宗崩，壬午，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In Xuande year ten, spring, first month, the Xuanzong Emperor died; on renwu he assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the tenth year of Xuande the Xuanzong Emperor died; on renwu Zhu Qizhen took the throne.

sentences.zh: 遵遺詔大事白皇太后行。

translations.literal: Following the testament edict, great affairs were reported to the Grand Empress Dowager for decision.
translations.idiomatic: As the late emperor had commanded, weighty state matters were laid before the Grand Empress Dowager for her ruling.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，以明年為正統元年。

translations.literal: Great pardon under Heaven; the coming year was made Zhengtong year one.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the following year was declared the first year of the Zhengtong reign.

sentences.zh: 始罷午朝。

translations.literal: The noon court audience was first abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The midday audience at court was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，尚書蹇義卒。

translations.literal: On dinghai Minister Jian Yi died.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Minister of Works Jian Yi died.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，戶部尚書黃福參贊南京守備機務。

translations.literal: On xinchou Minister of Revenue Huang Fu participated in deliberating Nanjing defense affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Huang Fu, minister of revenue, was assigned to assist in Nanjing garrison and defense planning.

sentences.zh: 二月戊申，尊皇太后為太皇太后。

translations.literal: In the second month on wushen the Empress Dowager was honored Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the second month the empress dowager was elevated to grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，尊皇后為皇太后。

translations.literal: On gengxu the Empress was honored Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the empress was made empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，封弟祁鈺為郕王。

translations.literal: On xinhai his younger brother Qiyu was enfeoffed Prince of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai his younger brother Zhu Qiyu was enfeoffed as Prince of Cheng.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，罷諸司冗費。

translations.literal: On jiayin redundant expenses of the various offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin superfluous spending across the ministries was cut.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，放教坊司樂工三千八百餘人。

translations.literal: In the third month on wuyin more than 3,800 musicians of the Music Office were released.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the third month over thirty-eight hundred performers of the imperial music service were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，罷山陵夫役萬七千人。

translations.literal: On xinsi corvée labor for the imperial tombs, 17,000 men, was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi seventeen thousand tomb laborers were sent home.

sentences.zh: 丙申，諭三法司，死罪臨決，三覆奏然後加刑。

translations.literal: On bingshen the Three Judicial Offices were instructed: for death sentences at the moment of execution, after threefold memorial review only then was punishment applied.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the three chief legal offices were ordered that no capital sentence might be carried out until it had been memorialized and reviewed three times.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬戌，以元學士吳澄從祀孔子廟庭。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on renxu Yuan scholar Wu Cheng was added to sacrifice in the Confucius temple court.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the fourth month Wu Cheng of the Yuan was enshrined in the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以久旱考察布、按二司及府州縣官。

translations.literal: On dingmao because of long drought the provincial surveillance and administration commissioners and prefectural, departmental, and county officials were examined.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, after prolonged drought, provincial and local officials were called to account.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，遣給事中、御史捕畿南、山東、河南、淮安蝗。

translations.literal: On wuchen supervising secretaries and censors were sent to capture locusts in the capital region south, Shandong, Henan, and Huai'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen censors and supervising secretaries were dispatched to destroy locusts south of the capital, and in Shandong, Henan, and Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，戶部言浙江、蘇、松荒田稅糧減除二百七十七萬餘石，請加覆覈。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on renwu the Ministry of Revenue reported that tax grain on wasteland in Zhejiang, Suzhou, and Songjiang had been reduced by more than 2,770,000 shi; it requested further verification.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the fifth month the ministry of revenue reported that grain levies on abandoned fields in Zhejiang, Suzhou, and Songjiang had already been cut by more than 2.77 million shi and asked for another audit.

sentences.zh: 帝以覈實必增額為民患，不許。

translations.literal: The Emperor, considering that verification in fact would necessarily increase quotas and become a hardship for the people, did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor refused, fearing a fresh audit would only raise quotas and burden the people.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，令天下瘞暴骸。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on dingwei the empire was ordered to bury exposed corpses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the sixth month the throne commanded every province to inter unburied dead.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，葬章皇帝於景陵。

translations.literal: On xinyou the Zhang Emperor was buried at Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the late Zhang Emperor Xuanzong was laid to rest at Jingling.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，免山西夏稅之半。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on bingzi half the summer tax of Shanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the seventh month Shanxi's summer tax was cut by half.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，減光祿寺膳夫四千七百餘人。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on bingwu more than 4,700 cooks of the Imperial Household were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the eighth month the imperial kitchen staff was trimmed by more than forty-seven hundred.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，詔督漕總兵及諸巡撫官，歲以八月至京會廷臣議事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on renchen an edict ordered the supreme commander of grain transport and touring pacification officials to come to the capital each year from the eighth month onward to confer with court ministers on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the ninth month grain-transport commanders and provincial grand coordinators were told to reach the capital every year from the eighth month on for joint deliberation with the court.

sentences.zh: 是月，王振掌司禮監。

translations.literal: That month Wang Zhen took charge of the Directorate of Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: That month the eunuch Wang Zhen assumed control of the Directorate of Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，遣使諭阿台兒只伯。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on renyin envoys were sent to instruct Atai Erduoboke.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the tenth month envoys were sent to warn the Mongol leader Atai Erduoboke.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔天下衛所皆立學。

translations.literal: On xinhai an edict ordered every guard and battalion in the empire to establish schools.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the throne commanded military garrisons throughout the realm to open schools.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on wuchen, first of the month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the new moon of the eleventh month, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬子，阿台朵兒只伯犯涼州鎮番，總兵官陳懋敗之於黑山。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on renzi Atai Erduoboke invaded Zhenfan in Liangzhou; supreme commander Chen Mao defeated him at Black Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the twelfth month Atai Erduoboke raided Zhenfan in Liangzhou; Chen Mao, supreme commander, routed him at Black Mountain.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、暹羅、日本、占城、安南、滿剌加、哈密、瓦剌入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu Zhongshan, Siam, Japan, Champa, Annam, Malacca, Hami, and the Oirats presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute missions came from Zhongshan in the Ryukyus, Siam, Japan, Champa, Annam, Malacca, Hami, and the Oirats.

sentences.zh: 正統元年

translations.literal: Zhengtong year one
translations.idiomatic: First year of the Zhengtong reign

sentences.zh: 正統元年春正月丙戌，罷銅仁金場。

translations.literal: In Zhengtong year one, spring, first month, on bingxu, the Tongren gold fields were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhengtong, on bingxu in the first month of spring, the state gold works at Tongren were closed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，發禁軍三萬人屯田畿輔。

translations.literal: On gengyin 30,000 forbidden troops were sent to open garrison farms in the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin thirty thousand palace guards were set to farm the lands around the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，賜周旋等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month on jisi Zhou Xuan and others among the presented scholars were granted jinshi with ranks and appointments differing.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the third month Zhou Xuan and the new jinshi graduates received their degrees and posts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，御經筵。

translations.literal: On yihai he attended the Classics Lecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the emperor presided over the lecture on the classics.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉朔，享太廟。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on dingyou, first of the month, he offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the new moon of the fourth month, he performed sacrifice at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，阿台朵兒只伯寇肅州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on dingmao Atai Erduoboke raided Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the fifth month Atai Erduoboke struck Suzhou in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，設提督學校官。

translations.literal: On renchen commissioners supervising schools were established.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the office of provincial education intendant was created.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲戌，右都督蔣貴充總兵官，都督同知趙安副之，帥師討阿台朵兒只伯。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn on jiaxu Right Censor-in-Chief Jiang Gui was made supreme commander, Vice Commissioner Zhao An his deputy, and they led troops to campaign against Atai Erduoboke.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the eighth month Jiang Gui, right censor-in-chief, was named supreme commander with Zhao An as deputy to take the field against Atai Erduoboke.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，遣侍郎何文淵、王佐，副都御史朱與言督兩淮、長蘆、浙江鹽課。

translations.literal: In the ninth month on guimao Vice Ministers He Wenyuan and Wang Zuo and Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhu Yuyan supervised salt revenue of the two Huai circuits, Changlu, and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the ninth month Vice Ministers He Wenyuan and Wang Zuo and Vice Censor Zhu Yuyan were sent to oversee the salt monopoly on the two Huai circuits, at Changlu, and in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 欽差巡鹽自此始。

translations.literal: Imperially commissioned salt inspection began from this.
translations.idiomatic: The practice of sending special envoys to inspect the salt administration dates from this.

sentences.zh: 庚申，封黎利子麟為安南國王。

translations.literal: On gengshen Li Lin, son of Li Li, was enfeoffed King of Annam.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Li Lin, son of the rebel Li Li, was recognized as king of Annam.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙卯，詔京官三品以上舉堪任御史者，四品及侍從言官舉堪任知縣者，各一人。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter on yimao an edict ordered capital officials of third rank and above each to recommend one man fit to serve as censor, and fourth-rank officials and attendant remonstrance officials each to recommend one fit to serve as magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the eleventh month ministers of third rank and above were told to nominate one man apiece for the censorate, while fourth-rank officials and palace remonstrators were to name candidates for county magistracies.

sentences.zh: 免湖廣被災稅糧。

translations.literal: Tax grain of disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Grain taxes were forgiven in the flood-stricken districts of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁丑，以邊議稽緩，下兵部尚書王驥、侍郎鄺埜於獄，尋釋之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on dingchou, because border deliberations had dragged, Minister of War Wang Ji and Vice Minister Kuang Ye were imprisoned; soon they were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the twelfth month Wang Ji, minister of war, and Vice Minister Kuang Ye were jailed for slow handling of frontier policy, then freed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，湖廣、貴州總兵官蕭授討廣西蒙顧十六洞賊，平之。

translations.literal: On yiyou Huguang-Guizhou supreme commander Xiao Shou campaigned against the bandits of the sixteen caves of western Guangxi Menggu and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Xiao Shou, supreme commander of Huguang and Guizhou, crushed the rebels of the sixteen cave districts of Menggu in western Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、爪哇、安南、烏斯藏、占城、瓦剌入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu Zhongshan, Java, Annam, U-Tsang, Champa, and the Oirats presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year missions arrived from Zhongshan in the Ryukyus, Java, Annam, Tibet, Champa, and the Oirats.

sentences.zh: 遣宣德時來貢古里、蘇門答剌十一國使臣還國。

translations.literal: Envoys of eleven states—Gujarat, Samudera, and the rest—that had come to court in tribute in the Xuande era were sent home.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven Xuande-era tributary missions—including Gujarat and Samudera—were sent back to their countries.

sentences.zh: 正統二年

translations.literal: Zhengtong year two
translations.idiomatic: Second year of the Zhengtong reign

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲午，宣宗神主祔太廟。

translations.literal: In year two, spring, first month, on jiawu, the Xuanzong Emperor's spirit tablet was placed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the first month of the second Zhengtong year the spirit tablet of Emperor Xuanzong was installed in the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 己亥，大同總兵官方政、都指揮楊洪會寧夏、甘肅兵出塞討阿台朵兒只伯。

translations.literal: On jihai Datong supreme commander Fang Zheng and Regional Commander Yang Hong joined Ningxia and Gansu troops in a campaign beyond the border against Atai Erduoboke.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Fang Zheng of Datong and Yang Hong, regional commander, led Ningxia and Gansu forces across the frontier against Atai Erduoboke.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，錄囚。

translations.literal: In the third month on jiawu prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the third month the court held a jail delivery.

sentences.zh: 戊午，御史金敬撫輯大名及河南、陝西逃民。

translations.literal: On wuwu Censor Jin Jing gathered and settled fugitive people of Daming, Henan, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Jin Jing, investigating censor, registered and resettled refugees in Daming, Henan, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，免河南被災田糧。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, grain tax of disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month drought-stricken Henan was granted remission of field tax.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，兵部尚書王驥經理甘肅邊務。

translations.literal: In the fifth month on gengyin Minister of War Wang Ji supervised Gansu border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the fifth month Wang Ji, minister of war, was sent to manage Gansu frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，刑部尚書魏源經理大同邊務。

translations.literal: On renyin Minister of Justice Wei Yuan supervised Datong border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Wei Yuan, minister of justice, took charge of the Datong frontier.

sentences.zh: 丁未，免陝西平涼六府旱災夏稅。

translations.literal: On dingwei half the summer tax of the six prefectures of Pingliang in Shaanxi stricken by drought was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei summer tax was halved in the six drought-hit prefectures of Pingliang circuit in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，以宋胡安國、蔡沈、真德秀從祀孔子廟庭。

translations.literal: On yihai Song Hu Anguo, Cai Shen, and Zhen Dexiu were added to sacrifice in the Confucius temple court.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Song scholars Hu Anguo, Cai Shen, and Zhen Dexiu were enshrined in the Confucian temple.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，副都御史賈諒、侍郎鄭辰振河南、江北饑。

translations.literal: On gengchen Vice Censor-in-Chief Jia Liang and Vice Minister Zheng Chen brought relief to famine in Henan and the Jianghuai north.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Jia Liang, vice censor-in-chief, and Vice Minister Zheng Chen were dispatched to relieve famine on the North Huai and in Henan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲子，鎮守甘肅左副總兵任禮充總兵官，都督蔣貴、都督同知趙安為左、右副總兵，兵部侍郎柴車，僉都御史曹翼、羅亨信參贊軍務，討阿台朵兒只伯。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on jiazi Left Deputy Supreme Commander Ren Li of Gansu was made supreme commander; Commissioners Jiang Gui and Zhao An were left and right deputies; Minister of War Vice Minister Chai Che and Censors-in-Chief Cao Yi and Luo Hengxin participated in deliberating military affairs, to campaign against Atai Erduoboke.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the tenth month Ren Li, deputy commander in Gansu, was named supreme commander with Jiang Gui and Zhao An as his lieutenants; Chai Che of the war ministry and Censors Cao Yi and Luo Hengxin joined the staff to pursue Atai Erduoboke.

sentences.zh: 兵部尚書王驥、太監王貴監督之。

translations.literal: Minister of War Wang Ji and Eunuch Wang Gui supervised them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji, minister of war, and the eunuch Wang Gui oversaw the campaign.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，振河南饑，免稅糧。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month on yisi famine in Henan was relieved; tax grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi in the eleventh month grain was issued to relieve famine in Henan and taxes there were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、撒馬兒罕、暹羅、土魯番、瓦剌、哈密入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu Zhongshan, Samarkand, Siam, Turfan, the Oirats, and Hami presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute came from Zhongshan in the Ryukyus, Samarkand, Siam, Turfan, the Oirats, and Hami.

sentences.zh: 正統三年

translations.literal: Zhengtong year three
translations.idiomatic: Third year of the Zhengtong reign

sentences.zh: 三年春三月己亥，京師地震。

translations.literal: In year three, spring, third month, on jihai the capital earthquaked.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the third month of the third Zhengtong year Beijing was shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，振陝西饑。

translations.literal: On xinchou famine in Shaanxi was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou relief grain was sent to famine districts in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙卯，王驥、任禮、蔣貴、趙安襲擊阿台朵兒只伯，大破之，追至黑泉還。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer on yimao Wang Ji, Ren Li, Jiang Gui, and Zhao An raided Atai Erduoboke and utterly defeated him; they pursued to Black Spring and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the fourth month Wang Ji, Ren Li, Jiang Gui, and Zhao An smashed Atai Erduoboke's army and chased the fugitives to Black Spring before turning back.

sentences.zh: 癸未，立大同馬市。

translations.literal: On guiwei the Datong horse market was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei a horse fair was opened at Datong.

sentences.zh: 六月癸酉，以旱讞中外疑獄。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on guiyou, because of drought, doubtful cases inside and outside were judged.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the sixth month, amid drought, the throne reviewed contested criminal cases throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，都督方政、僉事張榮同征南將軍黔國公沐晟、右都督沐昂，討麓川叛蠻思任發。

translations.literal: On yihai Commissioner Fang Zheng and Assistant Commander Zhang Rong, together with the southern campaign general Duke of Qian Mu Sheng and Right Censor-in-Chief Mu Ang, campaigned against the Luchuan rebel Man Si Renfa.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Fang Zheng and Zhang Rong joined the southern expedition led by Mu Sheng, duke of Qian, and Mu Ang, right censor-in-chief, against the Luchuan rebel Si Renfa.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未，下禮部尚書胡濙於獄。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on guiwei Minister of Rites Hu Ying was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the seventh month Hu Ying, minister of rites, was thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，下戶部尚書劉中敷於獄。

translations.literal: On xinmao Minister of Revenue Liu Zhongfu was imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Liu Zhongfu, minister of revenue, was also jailed.

sentences.zh: 尋俱釋之。

translations.literal: Soon both were released.
translations.idiomatic: Before long both men were freed.

sentences.zh: 八月乙亥，以陝西饑，令雜犯死囚以下輸銀贖罪，送邊吏易米，九月癸巳，蠲兩畿、湖廣逋賦。

translations.literal: On yihai, because of famine in Shaanxi, miscellaneous offenders below death were ordered to pay silver to redeem punishment and sent to border officials to exchange for grain; in the ninth month on guisi arrears of tax in the two capitals regions and Huguang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, with Shaanxi starving, lesser criminals were allowed to buy remission with silver and the proceeds were used to buy grain on the frontier; on guisi in the ninth month back taxes in the metropolitan districts and Huguang were canceled.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，再振陝西饑。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter on guichou famine in Shaanxi was relieved again.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the tenth month Shaanxi received a second issue of famine relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，下刑部尚書魏源、右都御史陳智等於獄。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month on bingchen Minister of Justice Wei Yuan, Right Censor-in-Chief Chen Zhi, and others were imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the twelfth month Wei Yuan, minister of justice, Chen Zhi, right censor-in-chief, and others were arrested.

sentences.zh: 是年，榜葛剌貢麒麟，中外表賀．琉球中山、暹羅、占城、瓦剌入貢。

translations.literal: That year Bengal presented tribute of a qilin; inside and outside the court congratulated. Ryukyu Zhongshan, Siam, Champa, and the Oirats presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Bengal sent a giraffe as tribute and court and country alike rejoiced; missions also came from Zhongshan in the Ryukyus, Siam, Champa, and the Oirats.

sentences.zh: 正統四年

translations.literal: Zhengtong year four
translations.idiomatic: Fourth year of the Zhengtong reign

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬午，方政破麓川蠻於大寨，追至空泥，敗沒。

translations.literal: In year four, spring, first month, on renwu, Fang Zheng defeated the Luchuan Man at Great Stockade, pursued to Kongni, and was destroyed in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the first month Fang Zheng routed the Luchuan tribes at Great Stockade and chased them to Kongni, where he was killed and his army wiped out.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，總兵官蕭授平貴州計砂叛苗。

translations.literal: In the second month on dingsi supreme commander Xiao Shou pacified the rebellious Miao of Jisha in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the second month Xiao Shou, supreme commander, subdued the Jisha Miao rebels in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛丑，釋魏源、陳智等，復其官，并宥棄交阯王通、馬騏罪。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month on xinchou Wei Yuan, Chen Zhi, and others were released, their offices restored, and at the same time pardon was granted to Wang Tong and Ma Qi, who had abandoned Jiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the intercalary month Wei Yuan, Chen Zhi, and the rest were freed and reinstated, and Wang Tong and Ma Qi were pardoned for abandoning Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: In the third month on jiyou an edict pardoned the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the third month a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜施槃等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On renzi Shi Pan and others among the presented scholars were granted jinshi with ranks and appointments differing.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Shi Pan and the new jinshi graduates received their degrees and posts according to rank.

sentences.zh: 庚申，廢遼王貴烚為庶人。

translations.literal: On gengshen Prince of Liao Guihuang was demoted to commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the Prince of Liao, Guihuang, was stripped of rank and reduced to common status.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，黔國公沐晟卒於軍。

translations.literal: On dingmao Duke of Qian Mu Sheng died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Mu Sheng, duke of Qian, died on campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，增南京及在外文武官軍俸廩。

translations.literal: On guiyou stipends of civil and military officials and troops at Nanjing and elsewhere were increased.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou salaries and rations were raised for officials and garrison troops at Nanjing and in the provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚戌，右都督沐昂為征南將軍，充總兵官，討思任發。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer on gengxu Right Censor-in-Chief Mu Ang was made southern campaign general, filled supreme commander, and campaigned against Si Renfa.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the fifth month Mu Ang, right censor-in-chief, was named supreme commander and southern campaign general to continue the war against Si Renfa.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，錄中外囚。

translations.literal: On dingmao prisoners inside and outside were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the court reviewed prisoners throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the sixth month on yiwei the capital earthquaked.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the sixth month Beijing shook again.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以京畿水災祭告天地，諭羣臣修省。

translations.literal: On dingyou, because of flood disaster in the capital region, sacrifice was offered to Heaven and Earth; the multitude of ministers was instructed to cultivate reflection.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, after floods around the capital, the emperor sacrificed to Heaven and Earth and urged his ministers to examine their conduct.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，下詔寬卹，求直言。

translations.literal: On wuxu an edict granted lenient relief and sought forthright speech.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict eased penalties and called for blunt counsel.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，免兩畿、山東、江西、河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn on gengxu tax grain of disaster-stricken areas in the two capitals regions, Shandong, Jiangxi, and Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the seventh month grain taxes were forgiven in the flood-hit districts of the metropolitan regions, Shandong, Jiangxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 壬申，汰冗官。

translations.literal: On renshen redundant officials were culled.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen superfluous posts in the bureaucracy were abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，增設沿海備倭官。

translations.literal: In the eighth month on wuxu coastal offices guarding against Japanese pirates were added.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the eighth month new posts were created to defend the coast against wokou raids.

sentences.zh: 己亥，京師地震。

translations.literal: On jihai the capital earthquaked.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Beijing was shaken by earthquake once more.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月丁丑，都督同知李安充總兵官，僉都御史王翶恭參贊軍務，討松潘祈命簇叛番。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter on dingchou Vice Commissioner Li An was made supreme commander; Censor-in-Chief Wang Ao respectfully participated in deliberating military affairs, to campaign against the rebellious Tibetans of the Qiming cluster in Songpan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the twelfth month Li An, vice commissioner, was named supreme commander with Wang Ao, censor-in-chief, on his staff to suppress the Qiming Tibetan rebels in Songpan.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、占城、安南、瓦剌、榜葛剌、滿剌加、哈密入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu, Champa, Annam, the Oirats, Bengal, Malacca, and Hami presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year missions arrived from the Ryukyus, Champa, Annam, the Oirats, Bengal, Malacca, and Hami.

sentences.zh: 正統五年

translations.literal: Zhengtong year five
translations.idiomatic: Fifth year of the Zhengtong reign

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, spring, first month, on the day jiwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, in the first month of spring, on jiwei, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，侍講學士馬愉、侍講曹鼐入閣預機務。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yihai, Lecturing Reader Ma Yu and Lecturer Cao Nai entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yihai, Lecturing Reader Ma Yu and Lecturer Cao Nai entered the Grand Secretariat to join in state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 甲申，僉都御史張純、大理少卿李畛振撫畿內流民。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Censor-in-Chief Zhang Chun and Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Li Zhen distributed relief among the refugee population within the metropolitan districts.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Censor-in-Chief Zhang Chun and Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Li Zhen opened relief for displaced people in the metropolitan districts.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，建北京宮殿。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wushen, the palaces at Beijing were constructed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wushen, work began on the palaces at Beijing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，免山西逋賦。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day renshen, overdue levies in Shanxi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renshen, overdue taxes in Shanxi were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，祈命簇番降。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the tribesmen of the Qiming cluster submitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the Qiming-cluster tribes submitted.

sentences.zh: 五月，征麓川，參將張榮敗績於芒市。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Luchuan was attacked; Deputy Commander Zhang Rong suffered defeat at Mangshi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the court marched against Luchuan; Deputy Commander Zhang Rong was routed at Mangshi.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，免兩畿被災田糧。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dingchou, tax grain was remitted for disaster-stricken fields in the Two Capitals districts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingchou, grain tax was waived in the disaster districts of both capitals.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the court held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛丑，遣刑部侍郎何文淵等分行天下，修備荒之政。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinchou, Vice Minister of Justice He Wenyuan and others were dispatched throughout the realm to implement famine-relief policies.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinchou, Vice Minister of Justice He Wenyuan and others were sent through the provinces to put famine-relief measures in order.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，楊榮卒。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Yang Rong died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Yang Rong died.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，令各邊修舉荒政。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yiwei, the frontier regions were ordered to carry out famine-relief measures.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiwei, every frontier command was ordered to press forward with famine relief.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，蠲雲南逋賦。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renyin, overdue levies in Yunnan were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renyin, overdue levies in Yunnan were remitted.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬寅，振浙江饑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on the day renyin, Zhejiang famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on renyin, grain relief was sent to famine-stricken Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，免蘇、松、常、鎮、嘉、湖水災稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, tax grain for flood disasters in Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi grain tax was forgiven in the flood districts of Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，廣西僧楊行祥偽稱建文帝，械送京師，錮錦衣衛獄死。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the Guangxi monk Yang Xingxiang falsely claimed to be the Jianwen Emperor, was sent to the capital in fetters, and died imprisoned in the Brocade Guard jail.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi a Guangxi monk, Yang Xingxiang, pretended to be the Jianwen Emperor; he was shackled and sent to the capital, and died in the Brocade Guard prison.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，沐昂討平師宗叛蠻。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Mu Ang campaigned against and pacified the rebellious tribesmen of Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Mu Ang campaigned against the rebel tribes of Shizong and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，免南畿、浙江、山東、河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day renwu, disaster-stricken tax grain was remitted in the Southern Capital districts, Zhejiang, Shandong, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renwu, grain tax was waived in the stricken districts of the southern capital region, Zhejiang, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、琉球中山、哈密、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Ryukyu Chuzan, Hami, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Champa, Ryukyu Chuzan, Hami, and Tibet.

sentences.zh: 正統六年

translations.literal: The sixth year of Zhengtong.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth year of the Zhengtong reign.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月己亥朔，日當食，不見，禮官請表賀，不許。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, spring, first month, on the new moon day jihai, an eclipse was due but not seen; the ritual officials requested a congratulatory memorial, but this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, at the new moon of the first month of spring, an eclipse was predicted for jihai but never appeared; the ritual officials asked leave to memorialize the omen, and the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以莊浪地屢震，躬祀郊廟，遣使祭西方嶽鎮。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, because the Zhuanglang region shook repeatedly, he personally sacrificed at the suburban altars and temples and dispatched envoys to sacrifice at the western mountains and passes.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, after repeated earthquakes in Zhuanglang, the Emperor sacrificed in person at the suburban altars and temples and sent envoys to offer sacrifice at the western mountains and passes.

sentences.zh: 大舉征麓川，定西伯蔣貴為平蠻將軍，都督同知李安、僉事劉聚副之，兵部尚書王驥總督軍務。

translations.literal: A great campaign was launched against Luchuan; Duke of Dingxi Jiang Gui was made Pacification General, with Assistant Commander-in-Chief Li An and Commissioner Liu Ju as deputies, and Minister of War Wang Ji as supreme commander of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The court launched a major campaign against Luchuan, appointing Duke of Dingxi Jiang Gui Pacification General, with Assistant Commander-in-Chief Li An and Commissioner Liu Ju as his deputies and Minister of War Wang Ji as supreme commander.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，下兵部侍郎于謙於獄。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengzi, Vice Minister of War Yu Qian was cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengzi, Vice Minister of War Yu Qian was thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，以災異遣使省天下疑獄。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiawu, because of prodigies and disasters envoys were dispatched to review doubtful cases throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiawu, owing to heaven-sent warnings, envoys were sent to review doubtful criminal cases across the empire.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，刑部侍郎何文淵、大理卿王文錄在京刑獄，巡撫侍郎周忱、刑科給事中郭瑾錄南京刑獄。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiayin, Vice Minister of Justice He Wenyuan and Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Wang Wen reviewed capital prisoners; Grand Coordinator Vice Minister Zhou Chen and Supervising Secretary of the Penal Section Guo Jin reviewed Nanjing prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiayin, Vice Minister of Justice He Wenyuan and Chief Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Wang Wen reviewed prisoners at the capital; Grand Coordinator Vice Minister Zhou Chen and Supervising Secretary Guo Jin of the Penal Section reviewed those at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 釋于謙為大理少卿。

translations.literal: Yu Qian was released and made Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Qian was released and appointed Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁未，振浙江、湖廣饑。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day dingwei, Zhejiang and Huguang famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingwei, relief was sent to famine victims in Zhejiang and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，戶部尚書劉中敷，侍郎吳璽、陳瑺荷校於長安門，旬餘釋還職。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingchou, Minister of Revenue Liu Zhongfu and Vice Ministers Wu Xi and Chen Yao wore the cangue at Chang'an Gate; after more than ten days they were released and returned to office.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingchou, Revenue Minister Liu Zhongfu and Vice Ministers Wu Xi and Chen Yao were made to wear the cangue at Chang'an Gate; after ten days they were released and returned to their posts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，免畿內被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, disaster-stricken tax grain within the metropolitan districts was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin grain tax was waived in the disaster districts around the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午朔，乾清、坤寧二宮，奉天、華蓋、謹身三殿成，大赦。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the new moon day jiawu, the Qianqing and Kunning palaces and the three halls Fengtian, Huagai, and Jinshen were completed; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eleventh month, jiawu, the Qianqing and Kunning palaces and the three great halls—Fengtian, Huagai, and Jinshen—were finished, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 定都北京，文武諸司不稱行在。

translations.literal: Beijing was fixed as the capital; all civil and military offices no longer used the term traveling seat.
translations.idiomatic: Beijing was made the fixed capital, and civil and military departments ceased to call themselves the traveling court.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，王驥拔麓川上江寨。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Wang Ji captured the Upper River stockade in Luchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Wang Ji took the Upper River stockade in Luchuan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，免河南、山東及鳳陽等府被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, disaster-stricken tax grain was remitted in Henan, Shandong, and prefectures such as Fengyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou grain tax was forgiven in the disaster districts of Henan, Shandong, and such prefectures as Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲戌，復下劉中敷、吳璽、陳瑺於獄。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day jiaxu, Liu Zhongfu, Wu Xi, and Chen Yao were again cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiaxu, Liu Zhongfu, Wu Xi, and Chen Yao were jailed again.

sentences.zh: 踰年，釋中敷為民，璽、瑺戍邊。

translations.literal: After a year, Zhongfu was released to commoner status; Xi and Yao were banished to frontier service.
translations.idiomatic: A year later Zhongfu was released to private life, while Xi and Yao were banished to frontier garrison duty.

sentences.zh: 十二月，王驥克麓川，思任發走孟養。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Wang Ji conquered Luchuan; Si Renfa fled to Meng Yang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Wang Ji overran Luchuan, and Si Renfa fled toward Meng Yang.

sentences.zh: 丁未，班師。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the army marched home.

sentences.zh: 左副總兵李安攻餘賊於高黎貢山。

translations.literal: Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief Li An attacked the remnant bandits on Gaoligong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Left Deputy Commander-in-Chief Li An struck the remnant rebels on Gaoligong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 敗績。

translations.literal: He suffered defeat.
translations.idiomatic: He was routed.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、瓦剌、哈密入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Oirat, and Hami sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Champa, the Oirats, and Hami.

sentences.zh: 正統七年

translations.literal: The seventh year of Zhengtong.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh year of the Zhengtong reign.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, spring, first month, on the day jiaxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, in the first month of spring, on jiaxu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，如天壽山。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengshen, he went to Tianshou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengshen, he went to Tianshou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，還宮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day jiazi, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiazi, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，免陝西屯糧十之五。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, five-tenths of the garrison grain in Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai half the garrison grain levy in Shaanxi was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賜劉儼等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Liu Yan and other jinshi were granted metropolitan graduate and lower degrees in graded ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Liu Yan and the other jinshi received metropolitan graduate and lower degrees in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，振陝西饑。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiawu, Shaanxi famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiawu, grain relief was sent to famine-stricken Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 是月，免山西、河南、山東被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That month, disaster-stricken tax grain was remitted in Shanxi, Henan, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: That month grain tax was waived in the disaster districts of Shanxi, Henan, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，論平麓川功，進封蔣貴為侯，王驥靖遠伯。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renshen, merit in pacifying Luchuan was assessed; Jiang Gui was advanced to marquis, and Wang Ji was made Earl of Jingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renshen, rewards were granted for pacifying Luchuan: Jiang Gui was ennobled as marquis and Wang Ji as Earl of Jingyuan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，立皇后錢氏。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the Qian clan was established as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Lady Qian was made empress.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，倭陷大嵩所。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Japanese pirates took Dasong guard post.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Japanese raiders overran Dasong guard post.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，戶部侍郎焦宏備倭浙江。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renzi, Vice Minister of Revenue Jiao Hong was ordered to prepare against Japanese pirates in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renzi, Vice Minister of Revenue Jiao Hong was sent to ready defenses against Japanese pirates in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅，振陝西饑民，贖民所鬻子女。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day bingyin, Shaanxi famine victims were relieved, and children sold by the people were redeemed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingyin, Shaanxi famine victims received relief and children sold by their families were bought back.

sentences.zh: 八月壬寅，復命王驥總督雲南軍務。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day renyin, Wang Ji was again ordered to command military affairs in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renyin, Wang Ji was again placed in overall command of military affairs in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，陝西進嘉禾，禮臣請表賀，不許。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiaxu, Shaanxi presented auspicious grain; the ritual officials requested a congratulatory memorial, but this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiaxu, Shaanxi sent up stalks of auspicious grain; the ritual officials asked to memorialize the omen, and the Emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬辰，兀良哈犯廣寧。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day renchen, the Urianghad invaded Guangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renchen, Urianghad bands invaded Guangning.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太皇太后崩．十二月，葬誠孝昭皇后於獻陵。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Grand Empress Dowager died. In the twelfth month, Empress Chengxiao Zhao was buried at Xian Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Grand Empress Dowager died. In the twelfth month Empress Chengxiao Zhao was buried at Xian Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、瓦剌、哈密、琉球中山、安南、爪哇、土魯番、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Oirat, Hami, Ryukyu Chuzan, Annam, Java, Turfan, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Champa, the Oirats, Hami, Ryukyu Chuzan, Annam, Java, Turfan, and Tibet.

sentences.zh: 正統八年

translations.literal: The eighth year of Zhengtong.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth year of the Zhengtong reign.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月丁卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, spring, first month, on the day dingmao, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, in the first month of spring, on dingmao, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，汰南京冗官。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jichou, superfluous officials at Nanjing were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jichou, redundant offices at Nanjing were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，淮王瞻墺來朝。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Prince of Huai Zhan Ao came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Prince of Huai Zhan Ao came to court.

sentences.zh: 丙午，荊王瞻堈來朝。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Prince of Jing Zhan Gang came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Prince of Jing Zhan Gang came to court.

sentences.zh: 夏五月己巳，復命平蠻將軍蔣貴、王驥帥師征麓川思任發子思機發。

translations.literal: In summer, the fifth month, on the day jisi, Pacification General Jiang Gui and Wang Ji were again ordered to lead troops against Si Jifa, son of Si Renfa of Luchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on jisi, Pacification General Jiang Gui and Wang Ji were again ordered to take the field against Si Jifa, son of the Luchuan chieftain Si Renfa.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，雷震奉天殿鴟吻，敕修省。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, lightning struck the ridge ornaments of Fengtian Hall; an edict ordered self-examination and reform.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin lightning struck the roof ornaments of Fengtian Hall, and the Emperor ordered the court to examine itself and reform.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥，侍講劉球陳十事，下錦衣衛獄，太監王振使指揮馬順殺之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day dinghai, Lecturer Liu Qiu laid out ten matters; he was cast into the Brocade Guard prison, and the eunuch Wang Zhen had Commander Ma Shun kill him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dinghai, Lecturer Liu Qiu memorialized on ten points; he was thrown into the Brocade Guard prison, and the eunuch Wang Zhen had Commander Ma Shun put him to death.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，下大理少卿薛瑄於獄。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Xue Xuan was cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Vice Minister of the Court of Judicial Review Xue Xuan was thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊午，祭酒李時勉荷校於國子監門三日。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wuwu, Administrator Li Shimian wore the cangue at the gate of the Directorate of Education for three days.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuwu, Administrator Li Shimian was made to wear the cangue at the gate of the Directorate of Education for three days.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，思機發請降。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiazi, Si Jifa requested surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiazi, Si Jifa asked to surrender.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，宣宗廢后胡氏卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, the deposed empress Hu of Emperor Xuanzong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter the deposed Empress Hu of Emperor Xuanzong died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸未，免山東復業民稅糧二年。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day guiwei, tax grain was remitted for two years to Shandong people returning to farming.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on guiwei, grain tax was forgiven for two years to Shandong families resuming cultivation.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，駙馬都尉焦敬荷校於長安右門。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, Chief Commandant of Horse Jiao Jing wore the cangue at Chang'an Right Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Chief Commandant of Horse Jiao Jing was made to wear the cangue at Chang'an Right Gate.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、安南、瓦剌、哈密、爪哇入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Annam, Oirat, Hami, and Java sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year embassies came from Champa, Annam, the Oirats, Hami, and Java.

sentences.zh: 正統九年

translations.literal: The ninth year of Zhengtong.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth year of the Zhengtong reign.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月甲寅，右都御史王文巡延安、寧夏邊。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, spring, first month, on the day jiayin, Right Censor-in-Chief Wang Wen inspected the Yan'an and Ningxia frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, in the first month of spring, on jiayin, Right Censor-in-Chief Wang Wen inspected the Yan'an and Ningxia frontier.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 辛未，成國公朱勇，興安伯徐亨，都督馬亮、陳懷，同太監僧保、曹吉祥、劉永誠、但住分道討兀良哈。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Duke of Chengguo Zhu Yong, Earl of Xing'an Xu Heng, Commanders Ma Liang and Chen Huai, together with the eunuchs Sengbao, Cao Jixiang, Liu Yongcheng, and Dan Zhu, campaigned against the Urianghad by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Duke of Chengguo Zhu Yong, Earl of Xing'an Xu Heng, Commanders Ma Liang and Chen Huai, and the eunuchs Sengbao, Cao Jixiang, Liu Yongcheng, and Dan Zhu took separate routes against the Urianghad.

sentences.zh: 二月丙午，王驥擊走思機發，俘其孥以獻。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day bingwu, Wang Ji routed Si Jifa and presented his wife and children as captives.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingwu, Wang Ji drove off Si Jifa and sent his family to the capital as captives.

sentences.zh: 召驥還。

translations.literal: Wang Ji was recalled.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji was recalled.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥朔，新建太學成，釋奠於先師孔子。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the new moon day xinhai, the newly built Directorate of Education was completed; libation was offered to the First Teacher Confucius.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the third month, xinhai, the newly built Directorate of Education was finished and libation was offered to Confucius as First Teacher.

sentences.zh: 甲子，朱勇等師還。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Zhu Yong and the others' armies returned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the armies of Zhu Yong and the others marched home.

sentences.zh: 楊士奇卒。

translations.literal: Yang Shiqi died.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Shiqi died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，敘征兀良哈功，封陳懷平鄉伯，馬亮招遠伯；

translations.literal: On the day yichou, merit in the campaign against the Urianghad was assessed; Chen Huai was enfeoffed as Earl of Pingxiang and Ma Liang as Earl of Zhaoyuan;
translations.idiomatic: On yichou rewards were granted for the Urianghad campaign: Chen Huai was enfeoffed Earl of Pingxiang and Ma Liang Earl of Zhaoyuan;

sentences.zh: 成國公朱勇等進秩有差。

translations.literal: Duke of Chengguo Zhu Yong and others were advanced in rank by graded steps.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Chengguo Zhu Yong and the others were promoted in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙戌，翰林學士陳循直文淵閣，預機務。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day bingxu, Hanlin Academician Chen Xun served directly in the Wenyuan Pavilion and participated in confidential affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on bingxu, Hanlin Academician Chen Xun joined the Wenyuan Pavilion of the Grand Secretariat to take part in state deliberations.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，振沙州及赤斤蒙古饑。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Shazhou and Chijin Mongol famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai grain relief was sent to famine victims in Shazhou and among the Chijin Mongols.

sentences.zh: 五月己未，命法司錄在京刑獄，刑部侍郎馬昂錄南京刑獄。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jiwei, the legal offices were ordered to review capital prisoners; Vice Minister of Justice Ma Ang reviewed Nanjing prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiwei, the legal offices were ordered to review prisoners at the capital; Vice Minister of Justice Ma Ang reviewed those at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，振湖廣、貴州蠻饑。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day renwu, Huguang and Guizhou tribal famine was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renwu, relief was sent to famine among the tribes of Huguang and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，下駙馬都尉石璟於獄。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiyou, Chief Commandant of Horse Shi Jing was cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiyou, Chief Commandant of Horse Shi Jing was thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 處州賊葉宗留盜福安銀礦，殺福建參議竺淵，癸丑，免河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: The Chuzhou bandit Ye Zongliu plundered the silver mine at Fu'an and killed Fujian Administration Commissioner Zhu Yuan. On the day guichou, disaster-stricken tax grain in Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Zongliu of Chuzhou raided the silver mine at Fu'an and killed Fujian Administration Commissioner Zhu Yuan. On guichou grain tax was waived in the disaster districts of Henan.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊寅，復開福建、浙江銀場。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day wuyin, silver mines in Fujian and Zhejiang were reopened.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on wuyin, silver mines in Fujian and Zhejiang were reopened.

sentences.zh: 甲申，瘞暴骸。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, exposed corpses were buried.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen unburied corpses were interred.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，雷震奉先殿鴟吻。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, lightning struck the ridge ornaments of Fengxian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin lightning struck the roof ornaments of Fengxian Hall.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，免陝西被災稅糧，贖民所鬻子女。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengxu, disaster-stricken tax grain in Shaanxi was remitted, and children sold by the people were redeemed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu, grain tax was waived in disaster-stricken Shaanxi and children sold by their families were bought back.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，敕邊將備瓦剌也先。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, frontier generals were ordered to prepare against Esen of the Oirats.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu frontier generals were ordered to ready defenses against Esen of the Oirats.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，靖遠伯王驥、右都御史陳鎰經理西北邊備。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day dinghai, Earl of Jingyuan Wang Ji and Right Censor-in-Chief Chen Yi managed northwestern frontier defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai, Earl of Jingyuan Wang Ji and Right Censor-in-Chief Chen Yi were put in charge of northwestern frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon day bingwu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on the new moon of bingwu, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，兀良哈貢馬謝罪。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Wuliangha presented horses in tribute to beg pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Wuliangha brought tribute horses and sued for pardon.

sentences.zh: 是年，兩畿、山東、河南、浙江、湖廣大水，江河皆溢。

translations.literal: That year the Two Capitals districts, Shandong, Henan, Zhejiang, and Huguang suffered great floods; rivers everywhere overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: That year catastrophic floods struck the Two Capitals districts, Shandong, Henan, Zhejiang, and Huguang, and rivers burst their banks everywhere.

sentences.zh: 暹羅、琉球中山、瓦剌、安南、烏斯藏、滿剌加入貢。

translations.literal: Siam, Ryukyu Zhongshan, Oirat, Annam, U-Tsang, and Malacca paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Siam, Ryukyu's Zhongshan domain, the Oirats, Annam, Tibet, and Malacca sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 正統十年

translations.literal: Zhengtong year ten.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 10

sentences.zh: 十年春正月丙戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring of the tenth year, the first month, on the day bingxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the tenth year, the first month, on bingxu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔舉智勇之士。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, an edict ordered the recommendation of men of wisdom and courage.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the court called for men of wisdom and courage to be recommended.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingsi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingsi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己未，免陝西逋賦。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Shaanxi's overdue tax payments were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Shaanxi's tax arrears were remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，兀良哈貢馬，請貸犯邊者罪，不許。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Wuliangha presented horses and asked that the crimes of those who had violated the border be pardoned; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Wuliangha brought tribute horses and begged pardon for border raiders; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 壬申，如天壽山。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, he went to Tianshou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he traveled to Tianshou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，還宮。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingzi, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingzi, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，思機發入貢謝罪。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Si Jifa entered tribute to beg pardon.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Si Jifa sent a tribute mission to sue for pardon.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賜商輅等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Shang Lu and other jinshi were granted ranked honors of metropolitan graduate and lower degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Shang Lu and other jinshi received metropolitan graduate and lower degrees in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the first day jiachen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on the new-moon day jiachen, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔所在有司飼逃民復業及流移就食者。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, an edict ordered local officials in every place to provide food for fleeing people returning to their occupations and for migrants seeking sustenance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the throne ordered local officials everywhere to feed refugees returning to their fields and migrants seeking relief.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，振陝西饑，免田租三之二。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yichou, relief was sent for Shaanxi famine and two-thirds of the field tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yichou, grain relief was sent to famine in Shaanxi and two-thirds of the field tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙未，減糶河南、懷慶倉粟，濟山、陝饑。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day yiwei, grain from the Henan and Huaiqing granaries was sold at reduced price to relieve famine in Shandong and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yiwei, grain from the Henan and Huaiqing warehouses was sold cheap to relieve famine in Shandong and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，免湖廣旱災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guichou, Huguang's drought-stricken autumn grain tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guichou, Huguang's autumn grain tax for drought-stricken areas was remitted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，免蘇、松、嘉、湖十四府州水災秋糧。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the autumn grain tax for the fourteen prefectures and districts of Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou stricken by flood was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the autumn grain tax was remitted in fourteen prefectures and districts of Suzhou, Songjiang, Jiaxing, and Huzhou damaged by flood.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰，侍讀學士苗衷為兵部侍郎，侍講學士高穀為工部侍郎，並入閣預機務。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day wuchen, Reader-in-waiting Miao Zhong was made Vice Minister of War and Lecturer-in-waiting Gao Gu was made Vice Minister of Works; both entered the Grand Secretariat to deliberate on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on wuchen, Miao Zhong, reader-in-waiting, was appointed vice minister of war and Gao Gu, lecturer-in-waiting, vice minister of works; both entered the Grand Secretariat to share in deliberation.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，緬甸獲思任發，斬其首送京師。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingchen, Burma captured Si Renfa, beheaded him, and sent the head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingchen, Burma seized Si Renfa, beheaded him, and sent the head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，輸河南粟振陝西饑。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Henan grain was transported to relieve Shaanxi famine.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu grain from Henan was shipped to relieve famine in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: [1]廣西總兵官安遠侯柳溥討平慶遠叛蠻。

translations.literal: [1] Guangxi Commander-in-chief Liu Bo, Marquis of Anyuan, pacified the rebellious tribes of Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: [1] Liu Bo, Marquis of Anyuan and commander-in-chief of Guangxi, pacified the rebel tribes of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、哈密、亦力把里、安南、占城、滿剌加、錫蘭山、撒馬兒罕、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu Zhongshan, Hami, Ili Balik, Annam, Champa, Malacca, Ceylon, Samarkand, and U-Tsang paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu's Zhongshan domain, Hami, Ili Balik, Annam, Champa, Malacca, Ceylon, Samarkand, and Tibet sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 正統十一年

translations.literal: Zhengtong year eleven.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 11

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月己卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring of the eleventh year, the first month, on the day jimao, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the eleventh year, the first month, on jimao, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，予太監王振等弟姪世襲錦衣衛官。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the eunuch Wang Zhen's younger brothers and nephews were granted hereditary offices in the Brocade Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the younger brothers and nephews of the eunuch Wang Zhen were granted hereditary posts in the Brocade Guard.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，異氣見華蓋、奉天殿，遣官祭告天地。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinyou, strange vapors appeared over Huagai and the Hall of Imperial Supremacy; officials were dispatched to offer sacrifice and report to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinyou, strange lights appeared over Huagai and the Hall of Imperial Supremacy, and envoys were sent to sacrifice and report to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔卹刑獄。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, an edict ordered compassionate treatment of prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the court ordered compassionate treatment of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，下戶部尚書王佐、刑部尚書金濂、右都御史陳鎰等於錦衣衛獄，尋釋之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuchen, Minister of Revenue Wang Zuo, Minister of Justice Jin Lian, Censor-in-chief of the Right Chen Yi, and others were imprisoned in the Brocade Guard prison; soon they were released.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuchen, Wang Zuo, minister of revenue, Jin Lian, minister of justice, Chen Yi, censor-in-chief of the right, and others were cast into the Brocade Guard prison and soon released.

sentences.zh: 壬申，御史柳華督福建、浙江、江西兵討礦賊。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Censor Liu Hua supervised troops of Fujian, Zhejiang, and Jiangxi to suppress mining bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Censor Liu Hua took command of Fujian, Zhejiang, and Jiangxi troops to suppress mining bandits.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，如天壽山．庚辰，還宮。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, he went to Tianshou Mountain. On the day gengchen, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he traveled to Tianshou Mountain; on gengchen he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏六月丙辰，京師地震。

translations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, on the day bingchen, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the sixth month, on bingchen, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸酉，增市廛稅鈔。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day guiyou, market-stall taxes in paper money were increased.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guiyou, market-stall taxes paid in paper notes were raised.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，楊溥卒。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Yang Pu died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Yang Pu died.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，免湖廣被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuxu, Huguang's disaster-stricken autumn grain tax was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuxu, Huguang's autumn grain tax for stricken areas was remitted.

sentences.zh: 庚申，下吏部尚書王直等於獄，尋釋之。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Minister of Personnel Wang Zhi and others were imprisoned; soon they were released.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Zhi, minister of personnel, and others were imprisoned and soon released.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，廣西瑤叛，執化州知州茅自得，殺千戶汪義。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day xinsi, the Yao of Guangxi rebelled, seized Huazhou prefect Mao Zide, and killed the chiliarch Wang Yi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinsi, the Yao of Guangxi rose in revolt, seized Huazhou Prefect Mao Zide, and killed Chiliarch Wang Yi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，遣給事中、御史分賚諸邊軍士。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the day jiayin, supervising secretaries and censors were dispatched to distribute gifts to frontier soldiers in separate assignments.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on jiayin, supervising secretaries and censors were sent in separate parties to bestow gifts on frontier soldiers.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，減殊死以下罪。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renshen, punishments below extraordinary capital crimes were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renshen, punishments short of extraordinary capital crimes were reduced.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、暹羅、安南、爪哇、回回哈密、占城、亦力把里、撒馬兒罕、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu Zhongshan, Siam, Annam, Java, Muslim Hami, Champa, Ili Balik, Samarkand, and U-Tsang paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu's Zhongshan domain, Siam, Annam, Java, Muslim Hami, Champa, Ili Balik, Samarkand, and Tibet sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 正統十二年

translations.literal: Zhengtong year twelve.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 12

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月癸酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring of the twelfth year, the first month, on the day guiyou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the twelfth year, the first month, on guiyou, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥，如天壽山。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guihai, he went to Tianshou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guihai, he traveled to Tianshou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 庚午，還宮。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙子，免杭、嘉、湖被災秋糧。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the disaster-stricken autumn grain tax of Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the autumn grain tax was remitted in Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou for stricken areas.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，免蘇、松、常、鎮被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day dingsi, the disaster-stricken autumn grain tax of Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on dingsi, the autumn grain tax was remitted in Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang for stricken areas.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，大理少卿張驥振濟寧及淮、揚饑。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jihai, Assistant Minister of Justice Zhang Ji brought relief to famine in Jining and the Huai-Yang region.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jihai, Zhang Ji, assistant minister of justice, brought relief to famine in Jining and along the Huai and Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，敕各邊練軍備瓦剌。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiachen, an imperial command ordered every frontier to drill troops in preparation against the Oirats.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiachen, the throne ordered every frontier to drill troops against the Oirats.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the first day gengshen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the new-moon day gengshen, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 九月乙未，馬愉卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day yiwei, Ma Yu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiwei, Ma Yu died.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、安南、占城、瓦剌、爪哇、哈密、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu Zhongshan, Annam, Champa, Oirat, Java, and Hami paid tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu's Zhongshan domain, Annam, Champa, the Oirats, Java, and Hami sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 正統十三年

translations.literal: Zhengtong year thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 13

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月丁酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring of the thirteenth year, the first month, on the day dingyou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the thirteenth year, the first month, on dingyou, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，詔責孟養宣慰司獻思機發。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuzi, an edict rebuked the Mengyang Pacification Commission for harboring Si Jifa.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi, an edict rebuked the Mengyang Pacification Commission for sheltering Si Jifa.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，賜彭時等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Peng Shi and other jinshi were granted ranked honors of metropolitan graduate and lower degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Peng Shi and other jinshi received metropolitan graduate and lower degrees in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 王驥仍總督軍務，都督同知宮聚為平蠻將軍，充總兵官，帥師討思機發。

translations.literal: Wang Ji continued as supreme commander of military affairs; Vice Commissioner-in-chief Gong Ju was made General Who Pacifies the Barbarians and acting commander-in-chief, leading an army to attack Si Jifa.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ji remained supreme commander; Gong Ju, vice commissioner-in-chief, was made General Who Pacifies the Barbarians and acting commander-in-chief and marched against Si Jifa.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，免浙江、江西、湖廣被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, the disaster-stricken autumn grain tax of Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, the autumn grain tax was remitted in Zhejiang, Jiangxi, and Huguang for stricken areas.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，遣使捕山東蝗。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingxu, envoys were dispatched to capture locusts in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu, envoys were sent to capture locusts in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，刑部侍郎丁鉉撫輯河南、山東災民。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Vice Minister of Justice Ding Xuan pacified disaster victims in Henan and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Ding Xuan, vice minister of justice, pacified disaster victims in Henan and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，河決大名，沒三百餘里，遣使蠲振。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day yiyou, the Yellow River burst its banks at Daming, inundating more than three hundred li; envoys were dispatched to remit taxes and give relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yiyou, the Yellow River burst at Daming and flooded more than three hundred li; envoys were sent to remit taxes and give relief.

sentences.zh: 己酉，河決河南，沒曹、濮、東昌，潰壽張沙灣，壞運道，工部侍郎王永和治之。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the Yellow River burst in Henan, inundating Cao, Pu, and Dongchang; it breached Shazhang in Shouzhang and ruined the transport route; Vice Minister of Works Wang Yonghe undertook repairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the Yellow River burst in Henan, flooding Cao, Pu, and Dongchang, breaching Shazhang in Shouzhang and wrecking the transport route; Wang Yonghe, vice minister of works, undertook repairs.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，福建賊鄧茂七作亂。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yimao, the Fujian bandit Deng Maoji rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yimao, the Fujian bandit Deng Maoji rose in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命御史丁瑄捕之。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Censor Ding Xuan was ordered to capture him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Censor Ding Xuan was ordered to capture him.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丙戌，寧陽侯陳懋充總兵官，保定伯梁珤、平江伯陳豫副之，太監曹吉祥、王瑾提督火器，刑部尚書金濂參贊軍務，討鄧茂七。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day bingxu, Chen Mao, Marquis of Ningyang, was made acting commander-in-chief with Liang Yao, Earl of Baoding, and Chen Yu, Earl of Pingjiang, as his deputies; the eunuchs Cao Jixiang and Wang Jin supervised firearms; Minister of Justice Jin Lian assisted in military affairs; they attacked Deng Maoji.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the eleventh month, on bingxu, Chen Mao, Marquis of Ningyang, was made acting commander-in-chief with Liang Yao, Earl of Baoding, and Chen Yu, Earl of Pingjiang, as deputies; the eunuchs Cao Jixiang and Wang Jin supervised firearms; Jin Lian, minister of justice, assisted in the campaign against Deng Maoji.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，處州賊流劫金華諸縣。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Chuzhou bandits raided and plundered the counties of Jinhua.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Chuzhou bandits raided and plundered the counties of Jinhua.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，永康侯徐安備倭山東。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Xu An, Marquis of Yongkang, prepared defenses against Japanese pirates in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Xu An, Marquis of Yongkang, prepared coastal defenses against Japanese pirates in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，廣東瑤賊作亂。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengwu, Yao bandits rose in rebellion in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengwu, Yao bandits rose in rebellion in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球中山、安南、占城入貢．瓦剌貢使三千人，賞不如例，遂構釁。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu Zhongshan, Annam, and Champa paid tribute. The Oirat sent a tribute mission of three thousand men; rewards fell short of precedent, and conflict was thus provoked.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu's Zhongshan domain, Annam, and Champa sent tribute missions. The Oirats sent three thousand tribute envoys; rewards fell short of precedent, and trouble followed.

sentences.zh: 正統十四年

translations.literal: Zhengtong year fourteen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 14

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月甲午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourteenth year, the first month, on the day jiawu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the fourteenth year, the first month, on jiawu, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，免浙江、福建銀課。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the silver-mining levy of Zhejiang and Fujian was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the silver-mining levy was remitted in Zhejiang and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳，御史丁瑄、指揮劉福擊斬鄧茂七於延平。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day dingsi, Censor Ding Xuan and Commander Liu Fu attacked and beheaded Deng Maoji at Yanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingsi, Censor Ding Xuan and Commander Liu Fu attacked and beheaded Deng Maoji at Yanping.

sentences.zh: 己巳，王驥破思機發於金沙江，又破之鬼哭山，班師。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Wang Ji defeated Si Jifa at the Jinsha River and again at Ghost Weeping Mountain, then withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Wang Ji routed Si Jifa at the Jinsha River and again at Ghost Weeping Mountain, then withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 辛未，指揮僉事徐恭充總兵官，討處州賊葉宗留，工部尚書石璞參贊軍務。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Commander Xu Gong was made acting commander-in-chief to attack the Chuzhou bandit Ye Zongliu; Minister of Works Shi Pu assisted in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Commander Xu Gong was made acting commander-in-chief to attack the Chuzhou bandit Ye Zongliu; Shi Pu, minister of works, assisted in the campaign.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子，如天壽山。
