translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuzi, he went to Tianshou Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi, he traveled to Tianshou Mountain.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，還宮。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，處州賊犯崇安，殺都指揮吳剛。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day gengxu, Chuzhou bandits attacked Chong'an and killed Regional Commander Wu Gang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on gengxu, Chuzhou bandits attacked Chong'an and killed Regional Commander Wu Gang.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，湖廣、貴州苗賊大起，命王驥討之。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Miao bandits rose on a great scale in Huguang and Guizhou; Wang Ji was ordered to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Miao bandits rose on a great scale in Huguang and Guizhou, and Wang Ji was ordered to attack them.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，遣御史十三人同中官督福建、浙江銀課。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, thirteen censors were dispatched together with palace eunuchs to supervise the silver-mining levy in Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou thirteen censors were sent with palace eunuchs to supervise the silver-mining levy in Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，陳懋擊破沙縣賊。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingxu, Chen Mao defeated the bandits of Shaxian.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu, Chen Mao defeated the bandits of Shaxian.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，旱，太監金英同法司錄囚。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, there was drought; the eunuch Jin Ying together with the judiciary reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen drought struck; the eunuch Jin Ying joined the judiciary in reviewing prisoners.

sentences.zh: 己亥，侍讀學士張益直文淵閣，預機務。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Reader-in-waiting Zhang Yi was assigned direct duty at the Wenyuan Pavilion to deliberate on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zhang Yi, reader-in-waiting, was assigned direct duty at the Wenyuan Pavilion to share in deliberation.

sentences.zh: 庚子，巡按福建御史汪澄棄市，并殺前巡按御史柴文顯。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Fujian touring censor Wang Cheng was executed in the market, and the former touring censor Chai Wenxian was also killed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Fujian touring censor Wang Cheng was executed in the market, and the former touring censor Chai Wenxian was killed as well.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，靖州苗犯辰溪，都指揮高亮戰死。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengxu, Jingzhou Miao attacked Chenxi; Regional Commander Gao Liang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengxu, Jingzhou Miao attacked Chenxi and Regional Commander Gao Liang fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，南京謹身諸殿災。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, several halls of the Jinshen complex in Nanjing burned.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen several halls of the Jinshen complex in Nanjing burned.

sentences.zh: 甲子，修省。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the court undertook self-reform and austerity.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the court undertook self-reform and austerity.

sentences.zh: 詔河南、山西班軍番休者盡赴大同、宣府．乙丑，西寧侯宋瑛總督大同兵馬。

translations.literal: An edict ordered rotational-leave garrison troops of Henan and Shanxi all to proceed to Datong and Xuanfu. On the day yichou, Song Ying, Marquis of Xining, supervised military affairs at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Henan and Shanxi garrison troops on rotational leave to march to Datong and Xuanfu. On yichou Song Ying, Marquis of Xining, took command of military affairs at Datong.

sentences.zh: 己巳，赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，平鄉伯陳懷，駙馬都尉井源，都督王貴、吳克勤，太監林壽，分練京軍於大同、宣府，備瓦剌。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Chen Huai, Earl of Pingxiang, Chief Commandant-escort Jing Yuan, Commissioners Wang Gui and Wu Keqin, and the eunuch Lin Shou were assigned in separate parties to drill capital troops at Datong and Xuanfu in preparation against the Oirats.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Chen Huai, Earl of Pingxiang, Chief Commandant-escort Jing Yuan, Commissioners Wang Gui and Wu Keqin, and the eunuch Lin Shou were assigned in separate parties to drill capital troops at Datong and Xuanfu against the Oirats.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，瓦剌也先寇大同，參將吳浩戰死，下詔親征。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jichou, Esen of the Oirats raided Datong; Vice Commissioner Wu Hao died in battle, and an edict ordered the Emperor's personal campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jichou, Esen of the Oirats raided Datong; Vice Commissioner Wu Hao fell in battle, and the throne ordered a personal campaign.

sentences.zh: 吏部尚書王直帥羣臣諫，不聽。

translations.literal: Minister of Personnel Wang Zhi led the officials in remonstrance; this was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhi, minister of personnel, led the officials in remonstrance, but the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命郕王居守。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the Prince of Cheng was ordered to remain and guard the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the Prince of Cheng was ordered to remain and guard the capital.

sentences.zh: 是日，西寧侯宋瑛、武進伯朱冕與瓦剌戰於陽和，敗沒。

translations.literal: That day Song Ying, Marquis of Xining, and Zhu Mian, Earl of Wujin, fought the Oirats at Yanghe and were defeated and lost.
translations.idiomatic: That same day Song Ying, Marquis of Xining, and Zhu Mian, Earl of Wujin, fought the Oirats at Yanghe and were wiped out.

sentences.zh: 甲午，發京師。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the army set out from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the army set out from the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙未，次龍虎臺，軍中夜驚。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, it halted at Longhu Terrace; there was a night alarm in the army.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the host halted at Longhu Terrace, and the army panicked in the night.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，次居庸關。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, it halted at Juyong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the host halted at Juyong Pass.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，次宣府。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, it halted at Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the host halted at Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 羣臣屢請駐蹕，不許。

translations.literal: The officials repeatedly asked that he halt his progress; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The officials repeatedly begged him to halt his march, but he would not consent.

sentences.zh: 丙午，次陽和。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, it halted at Yanghe.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the host halted at Yanghe.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，次大同。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wushen, he halted at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wushen, the Emperor encamped at Datong.

sentences.zh: 鎮守太監郭敬諫，議旋師。

translations.literal: Guo Jing, the defender-attendant eunuch, remonstrated and urged withdrawal.
translations.idiomatic: Defender-attendant eunuch Guo Jing remonstrated and urged a withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 己酉，廣寧伯劉安為總兵官，鎮大同。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Liu An, Baron of Guangning, was made commander-in-chief and stationed at Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Liu An, Baron of Guangning, was made overall commander and posted to Datong.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，師還。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the army turned back.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，次宣府。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, he halted at Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi he encamped at Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 庚申，瓦剌兵大至，恭順侯吳克忠、都督吳克勤戰沒，成國公朱勇、永順伯薛綬救之，至鷂兒嶺遇伏，全軍盡覆。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Oirat troops arrived in force; Marquis of Gongshun Wu Kexiong and Regional Commander Wu Keqin fell in battle; Duke of Cheng Zhu Yong and Earl of Yongshun Xue Sui went to their rescue—at Ya'er Ridge they met an ambush and the whole army was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Oirat forces came in strength; Wu Kexiong, Marquis of Gongshun, and Regional Commander Wu Keqin fell in battle; Zhu Yong, Duke of Cheng, and Xue Sui, Earl of Yongshun, marched to relieve them but at Ya'er Ridge met an ambush and the entire host was wiped out.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，次土木，被圍。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, he halted at Tumu and was besieged.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he halted at Tumu and was surrounded.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，師潰，死者數十萬。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the army collapsed; several hundred thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the army broke; deaths ran into the hundreds of thousands.

sentences.zh: 英國公張輔，泰寧侯陳瀛，駙馬都尉井源，平鄉伯陳懷，襄城伯李珍，遂安伯陳塤，修武伯沈榮，都督梁成、王貴，尚書王佐、鄺埜，學士曹鼐、張益，侍郎丁鉉、王永和、[2]副都御史鄧棨等，皆死，帝北狩。

translations.literal: Duke of Ying Zhang Fu, Marquis of Taining Chen Ying, Commander of Horse Jing Yuan, Baron of Pingxiang Chen Huai, Baron of Xiangcheng Li Zhen, Baron of Suian Chen Kun, Baron of Xiuwu Shen Rong, Regional Commanders Liang Cheng and Wang Gui, Ministers Wang Zuo and Kuang Ye, Academicians Cao Nai and Zhang Yi, Vice Ministers Ding Xuan and Wang Yonghe, [2] and Vice Censor-in-chief Deng Qi, among others—all perished; the Emperor went on a northern hunt.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fu, Duke of Ying; Chen Ying, Marquis of Taining; Jing Yuan, Commander of Horse; Chen Huai, Baron of Pingxiang; Li Zhen, Baron of Xiangcheng; Chen Kun, Baron of Suian; Shen Rong, Baron of Xiuwu; Regional Commanders Liang Cheng and Wang Gui; Ministers Wang Zuo and Kuang Ye; Academicians Cao Nai and Zhang Yi; Vice Ministers Ding Xuan and Wang Yonghe; and Vice Censor-in-chief Deng Qi, among others—all fell; the Emperor was borne north.

sentences.zh: 甲子，京師聞敗，羣臣聚哭於朝，侍講徐珵請南遷，兵部侍郎于謙不可。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the capital heard of defeat; officials gathered weeping at court; Lecturer Xu Cheng proposed relocating south; Vice Minister of War Yu Qian forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi word of defeat reached the capital; the court assembled in tears; Lecturer Xu Cheng urged removal to the south; Vice Minister Yu Qian forbade it.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，皇太后命郕王監國。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the Empress Dowager ordered the Prince of Cheng to act as regent.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the Empress Dowager ordered the Prince of Cheng to oversee the realm as regent.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，帝至大同。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the Emperor reached Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the captive Emperor reached Datong.

sentences.zh: 己巳，皇太后命立皇长子祖深為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Empress Dowager ordered the eldest imperial son Zushēn established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Empress Dowager had the eldest son, Zushēn, named Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 辛未，帝至威寧海子。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the Emperor reached Weining Lake.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he came to Weining Lake.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，至黑河。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, he reached the Black River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he reached the Black River.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，郕王即位，遙尊帝為太上皇帝。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guimao, the Prince of Cheng ascended the throne and honored the Emperor from afar as Retired Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, the Prince of Cheng took the throne and from afar honored the captive as Retired Emperor.

sentences.zh: 壬戌輸河南粟振陝西饑 壬戌，原作「壬辰」。

translations.literal: On renxu, Henan grain was sent to relieve famine in Shaanxi — renxu: the original text read renchen.
translations.idiomatic: "On renxu Henan grain was dispatched to relieve Shaanxi famine": the day-name originally read renchen.

sentences.zh: 按正統十年十二月庚子朔，不得有壬辰日。

translations.literal: Comment: in the tenth year of Zhengtong, the new moon of the twelfth month was gengzi; there could be no day renchen.
translations.idiomatic: Note: in the tenth year of Zhengtong the twelfth-month new moon fell on gengzi; a renchen day is impossible.

sentences.zh: 據《英宗實錄》卷一三六改。

translations.literal: Emended according to Imperial Diaries of Yingzong, fascicle 136.
translations.idiomatic: Corrected per the Yingzong Shilu, juan 136.

sentences.zh: 侍郎丁鉉王永和 丁鉉，原作「丁鈜」。

translations.literal: Vice Ministers Ding Xuan and Wang Yonghe — Ding Xuan: the original text read Ding Hong.
translations.idiomatic: "Vice Ministers Ding Xuan and Wang Yonghe": Ding Xuan, the original text read Ding Hong.

sentences.zh: 本書卷三二八

translations.literal: This book, juan 328
translations.idiomatic: The present History, juan 328

sentences.zh: 〈瓦剌傳〉

translations.literal: "Treatise on the Oirats"
translations.idiomatic: "Account of the Oirats"

sentences.zh: 、《英宗實錄》卷一八一都作「丁鉉」。

translations.literal: and Imperial Diaries of Yingzong, fascicle 181, all read "Ding Xuan."
translations.idiomatic: and the Yingzong Shilu, juan 181, both read "Ding Xuan."

sentences.zh: 按本書卷一六七王佐傳附有

translations.literal: Per the biography of Wang Zuo appended to juan 167 of this book
translations.idiomatic: Per the Wang Zuo biography appended in juan 167 of this book

sentences.zh: 〈丁鉉傳〉

translations.literal: "Treatise on Ding Xuan"
translations.idiomatic: "Account of Ding Xuan"

sentences.zh: ，事跡與紀合，據改。

translations.literal: his deeds agree with the annals; emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: his deeds match the annals; emended accordingly.
